settings.section.access.description: Choose how MCM is opened and connected to framework menus.
settings.section.navigation.description: Configure mod lists, navigation, and sorting.
settings.section.workflow.description: Choose how changes and comparisons behave.
settings.gameplay_shortcut.label: Gameplay Menu Shortcut
settings.gameplay_shortcut.description: Open MCM directly during loaded gameplay. Click the control and press a key to rebind it; the default is Home.
settings.layout_profile.label: Panel Size
settings.layout_profile.description: Choose how much space MCM uses. Automatic uses Full in game menus and Compact during gameplay.
settings.ui_scale.label: UI Scale
settings.ui_scale.description: Scale the entire MCM interface uniformly. The final scale is limited when needed to keep it on screen.
collections.compatibility_prompt: Ready to apply: {mods} mods, {settings} settings.\nWill be skipped: {skippedMods} unavailable mods and {skippedSettings} removed, read-only, or incompatible settings.\nApply everything compatible?
collections.compatibility_result: Applied {settings} settings across {mods} mods. Skipped {skippedMods} unavailable mods and {skippedSettings} incompatible settings.
collections.compatibility_none: Nothing compatible could be applied. Skipped {skippedMods} unavailable mods and {skippedSettings} incompatible settings.
onboarding.title: Set Up MCM {step}/{total}
onboarding.prefixes.message: Show CET, MS, and RCF tags before mod names? You can change this later in MCM Settings.
onboarding.favorites.message: Show Favorites controls and keep favorite mods at the top? You can change their appearance later in MCM Settings.
onboarding.apply_mode.message: When should MCM apply changes? Apply & Revert lets you review edits first. Apply on Change saves every edit immediately.
onboarding.list_selection.message: How should the selected item stand out? A frame is easier to spot at a glance. No frame gives the list a more minimal look and leaves more room for long names.
install_health.legacy_bootstrap: An old !MCM_Bootstrap folder is still installed. Delete bin/x64/plugins/cyber_engine_tweaks/mods/!MCM_Bootstrap, then restart the game.
install_health.clean_reinstall: Files left by an older MCM version were detected: {paths}. This can happen after a manual installation or when an update is installed over existing files. Please follow the update instructions on the mod page to update MCM cleanly.
settings.section.behavior.description: Choose when MCM applies your changes.
settings.auto_apply.label: Auto Apply
settings.auto_apply.description: Apply every change immediately. REVERT is unavailable after a change has been saved.
app.title: Mod Configuration Menu
app.subtitle: One interface. Every framework.
empty.title: Select a mod
empty.select: Choose a mod from the list on the left to view and change its settings.
empty.settings_unavailable: No settings are available for this mod yet. Load a save, or reopen MCM after the mod has started.
empty.no_matches: No mods match the current filter.
settings.section.general.description: Menu access, change application, and comparison options.
settings.section.sorting.description: Choose how mods and settings are ordered.
settings.section.presets.description: Choose what preset and Collection comparisons show.
settings.description_panel.label: Description Panel
settings.description_panel.description: Show contextual descriptions beside the settings list. Disable it to give the list more horizontal space.
settings.menu_entry.label: Main Menu Entry
settings.menu_entry.description: Choose whether the main menu entry is named MCM or MODS.
settings.framework_menu_redirect.label: Redirect Framework Menu Entries
settings.framework_menu_redirect.descrip: Open MCM from existing Native Settings, Mod Settings, and RCF menu entries and their assigned shortcuts. Disable this to keep those framework menus separate.
settings.provider_filter.label: Visible Mod Types
settings.provider_filter.description: Choose which types of mods appear in the list on the left.
settings.show_prefix.label: Show Framework Tag
settings.show_prefix.description: Show the CET, MS, or RCF tag before each mod name.
settings.default_indicator.label: Default Value Indicator
settings.default_indicator.description: Choose how settings that differ from their framework defaults are marked.
settings.list_selection.label: Selected List Item
settings.list_selection.description: Choose whether selected items in panel lists use a frame or highlighted text.
settings.preset_non_default.label: Show Only Non-Default Settings
settings.preset_non_default.description: Hide rows where the preset uses the default value.
settings.mod_sort.label: Mod List Sort
settings.mod_sort.description: Sort the left mod list alphabetically.
settings.sort_prefix.label: Sort By Framework Tag
settings.sort_prefix.description: Let CET, MS, and RCF tags affect the mod order.
settings.settings_order.label: Settings Order
settings.settings_order.description: Original keeps the order defined by the source mod.
status.framework_menu_redirect_on: Framework menu entries and shortcuts now open MCM.
status.framework_menu_redirect_off: Framework menu entries now open their original menus.
status.sort_prefix_on: Mods are sorted with framework tags.
status.sort_prefix_off: Framework tags do not affect sorting.
status.preset_non_default_on: Only values that differ from the defaults are shown.
error.invalid_row: This setting could not be displayed.
error.select_mod_for_presets: Select a mod before opening its presets.
error.preset_preview: This preset could not be previewed.
error.collection_load: This Collection could not be loaded.
presets.matches_current: This preset already matches the current configuration.
collections.title: Collections
collections.baseline_prompt: Save the current settings of every supported mod as a new Collection.
collections.update_prompt: Update {name} with the current settings of all {count} available mods? Data for unavailable mods will be kept.
collections.clean_missing_prompt: Remove data for {count} currently unavailable mods from {name}? This cannot be undone.
collections.empty: This collection does not contain any mods yet.
collections.first_use: Create an empty Collection or save your current setup.
collections.select: Select a collection from the list on the left.
collections.portable_directory: Backup folder: {path}. Keep a copy of this file somewhere safe — you can use it to restore your mod settings after reinstalling the game.
collections.import_empty: No .mcmcollection backups were found. Copy one into the folder shown above, then select REFRESH.
collections.import_select: Select a Collection backup from the list on the left.
collections.import_summary: This backup contains {mods} mods and {settings} settings.
collections.import_scope_warning: Importing creates a new Collection without changing your current settings. Missing mods are kept in the backup and can be restored after you install them again.
collections.import_prompt: Import {name} as a new local Collection? Its settings will not be applied automatically.
collections.delete_backup_prompt: Delete the backup {name}? This file cannot be recovered.
collections.export_prompt: Export {name} as a complete Collection backup? The file may include text entered by the user, so review it before sharing it publicly.
error.portable_collection_invalid: This Collection backup is damaged or incompatible.
presets.delete_linked_prompt: Delete {name}? It is used by {count} Collections. Those Collections will keep a copy of its current settings.
error.preset_references: MCM could not check which Collections use this preset.
presets.duplicate_prompt: Enter a name for the duplicated preset.
settings.favorites.label: Favorites Controls
settings.favorites.description: Choose how Favorites appear in the mod list. Off also disables favorite-first sorting without clearing saved Favorites.
onboarding.sidebar_scroll.message: Animate long names in the left list instead of shortening them with an ellipsis? Ping-Pong scrolling will be enabled; you can choose a different mode later in MCM Settings.
settings.sidebar_scroll.label: Sidebar Text Scrolling
settings.sidebar_scroll.description: Choose how long names move inside the left list. Only overflowing text is animated and remains clipped to the padded row boundary.
settings.sidebar_scroll_activation.label: Scroll Activation
settings.sidebar_scroll_activation.descr: Choose which sidebar rows animate when their text is too long.
settings.sidebar_scroll_speed.label: Scroll Speed
settings.sidebar_scroll_speed.descriptio: Choose how quickly overflowing sidebar text moves.
drafts.leave_prompt: {mod} has unapplied changes. Apply them before leaving?
status.modified_only_on: Showing only settings that differ from reliable defaults.
error.close_unavailable: MCM could not resume the Settings close request.
collections.cleanup_none: This Collection has no definitively unavailable content.
